expected.title: The registry build cache stops apt packages from floating, contradicting ADR 0013
expected.detail: With `cache-from`/`cache-to` on every CI run, BuildKit reuses the unpinned `apt-get update && apt-get install` layers until an earlier layer changes, so rebuilt images stop picking up newer Ubuntu packages, which ADR 0013 says they do.
